sections.executive_summary: The United States has expanded strikes against Iran to include oil tankers and approximately 100 targets, with the Strait of Hormuz declared under US control, while Hezbollah continues drone attacks on Israeli forces in southern Lebanon and Kuwait faces missile and drone threats. Iran's economy is collapsing rapidly under combined military and financial pressure. Multiple active fronts span the Gulf, Lebanon, Iraq, and Gaza.
iran: The US struck two Iranian oil tankers named Hak and Sinopa near the Jask coast, marking the first time American forces targeted Iranian tankers not for maritime blockade enforcement but in response to Iranian attacks on passing ships in the Strait of Hormuz, under a new policy described as tanker-versus-tanker (Source: VahidOnline/78187).
Three Basij fighters were killed in American strikes on Lavan island in the Strait of Hormuz, according to Iranian reports (Source: New_security8200/203571).

Iran's economy is accelerating collapse: the euro crossed 255,000 tomans for the first time, the dollar reached approximately 220,000 tomans, and the national currency lost over 10 percent of its value in two weeks following US economic pressure and UAE financial severance (Source: VahidOnline/78188).
President Trump stated that at least 65,000 protesters have been killed in Iran, according to Israeli presidential remarks (Source: New_security8200/203581).

CENTCOM reported that since tightening the blockade of Iranian ports, 86 commercial vessels have been rerouted, 3 vessels sidelined, and 2 vessels inspected, an increase of 2 vessels from the previous day (Source: rodast_omiddana/80233).
Prime Minister Netanyahu stated that all Israeli systems, under his guidance, are operating to overthrow the Iranian regime, which he said is on its last legs (Source: shin_persian/9424).
President Trump proposed renaming the Strait of Hormuz to Trump Strait, declaring it would be hotter than ever under US control (Source: shin_persian/9423).
israel: The IDF destroyed over 26 kilometers of underground infrastructure route in Gaza, conducted by the Northern Brigade and Yahalom combat engineering units (Source: idf_telegram/25033).

Sirens sounded overnight in several northern Israeli border communities due to a suspicious aerial target likely crossing from Lebanon; interceptor missiles were launched and results are under review with no injuries reported (Source: manniefabian/59081).

The IDF determined that an alert regarding drone infiltration in the Galilee finger was false, with several interceptors fired at a false target after initial investigation (Source: almogboker78/18111).

Hezbollah launched two explosive-laden drones at Israeli troops operating at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon; the IDF struck Hezbollah infrastructure in the Nabatieh area, one drone was shot down by troops, and no soldiers were injured (Source: manniefabian/59083).
Defense Minister Katz stated that as economic pressure on Iran increases, there is a very high likelihood Iran will attack, noting they like to attack on Jewish holidays (Source: pkpoi/143819).
The IDF heightened alert in the Gaza Strip due to a planned Hamas attack against Israeli forces; the planned attack did not materialize (Source: New_security8200/203580).
gaza_west_bank: Israeli forces invaded the city of Nablus from the Aroub checkpoint in the northern West Bank (Source: rasedal3ado138e/388443).

The IDF heightened alert in the Gaza Strip following an intelligence warning of a possible Hamas attack against Israeli forces in the enclave; the planned attack did not materialize (Source: New_security8200/203580).

The Chief Rabbis of Israel petitioned the Defense Minister and IDF Chief of Staff to lighten the sentences of Givati Brigade soldiers who were convicted after refusing to engage in operational activity in the Gaza Strip alongside a paramedic (Source: yediotnews25/134593).
The IDF destroyed over 26 kilometers of underground infrastructure route in Gaza, conducted by the Northern Brigade and Yahalom (Source: idf_telegram/25033).
Hezbollah maintains a major underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge in the Nabatieh area, with several operatives believed to still be present (Source: manniefabian/59083).
Israeli forces continue operating at Ali Taher Ridge and stated they will not allow terrorists in the area to advance and carry out attacks on troops (Source: manniefabian/59083).
lebanon: Southern Lebanon recorded 202 total alerts with 113 drones tracked, with the most monitored villages being Ali al-Taher (16), al-Nabitha al-Fouqa (15), Kfar Rman (13), Kfar Tbnit (13), and Shoukine (12) (Source: redlinkleb/40350).
Three drone strikes were recorded: two in Nabitha and one in al-Nabitha al-Fouqa, all targeting areas near the Ali Taher Ridge where Hezbollah operates (Source: redlinkleb/40350).
Twenty aerial strikes were recorded across southern Lebanon including locations in al-Nabitha al-Fouqa, Dqoun Kfar Rman, Ali al-Taher, al-Mansouri, and al-Qantara (Source: redlinkleb/40350).
Fifty-two artillery strikes were recorded across southern Lebanon, with the heaviest concentration in Dqoun Kfar Rman (15), al-Mansouri (7), and Wadi al-Sluqai (4) (Source: redlinkleb/40350).

Hezbollah launched two explosive-laden drones at Israeli troops at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon, prompting IDF strikes on Hezbollah infrastructure in the Nabatieh area (Source: manniefabian/59083).
Artillery shelling was reported in Wadi al-Hajir and Mifdon areas of southern Lebanon (Source: redlinkleb/40348, redlinkleb/40334).
syria_iraq: An armed group attacked a Popular Mobilization Forces checkpoint at Toum Kabri in Kirkuk province, northern Iraq, resulting in several killed and wounded transported to Toum Kabri hospital (Source: rodast_omiddana/80239).
Iraqi ambulances continued transporting Popular Mobilization Forces wounded to Toum Kabri hospital in Kirkuk governorate, northern Iraq (Source: naya_foriraq/89267).
Yemeni forces launched missiles toward Saudi mercenary positions in the city of Mocha, according to Iraqi media documentation (Source: naya_foriraq/89258).
The initial toll from the Toum Kabri checkpoint attack includes one martyr and one wounded, according to hospital sources (Source: naya_foriraq/89261).
gulf_states: Kuwait issued a formal warning over drone and missile attacks targeting its territory, according to Press TV (Source: presstv/205314).
Missile and drone attacks were reported targeting Kuwait, described as a major escalation in the Gulf region (Source: rasedal3ado138e/388477).
The UAE severed financial relations with Iran, contributing to the acceleration of Iran's economic collapse and currency devaluation (Source: VahidOnline/78188).

Al Jazeera reported that even the threat of maritime mines would be sufficient to disrupt shipping traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, as international shipping companies would assess passage as too risky (Source: SharghDaily/181591).
key_developments: The US struck two Iranian oil tankers near Jask and expanded strikes to approximately 100 targets inside Iran under a new tanker-versus-tanker policy, with the Strait of Hormuz declared under US control (Source: mamlekate/104294).

Hezbollah launched two explosive-laden drones at Israeli troops at Ali Taher Ridge in southern Lebanon; the IDF struck Hezbollah infrastructure in the Nabatieh area and one drone was shot down (Source: manniefabian/59083).
Three Basij fighters were killed in American strikes on Lavan island in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating the toll of US strikes on Iranian targets (Source: New_security8200/203571).
Kuwait issued a warning over drone and missile attacks targeting its territory, signaling expanding threat to Gulf states (Source: presstv/205314).
The IDF destroyed over 26 kilometers of underground infrastructure route in Gaza, conducted by the Northern Brigade and Yahalom units (Source: idf_telegram/25033).
An armed group attacked a Popular Mobilization Forces checkpoint at Toum Kabri in Kirkuk province, northern Iraq, killing and wounding several personnel (Source: rodast_omiddana/80239).

Iran's economy is collapsing rapidly with the euro crossing 255,000 tomans and the national currency losing over 10 percent in two weeks under combined US and UAE financial pressure (Source: VahidOnline/78188).
sections.threat_assessment: The United States is escalating military pressure on Iran across multiple domains, including strikes on oil infrastructure, approximately 100 targets inside Iran, and asserting control over the Strait of Hormuz with 86 commercial vessels rerouted. Hezbollah continues asymmetric operations from southern Lebanon using explosive-laden drones and maintaining underground facilities near the Nabatieh area. The threat to Gulf maritime security is intensifying with Kuwait under direct attack and mine threats reported in the Strait of Hormuz.
sections.regional_response: Gulf states are issuing formal warnings and reassessing maritime security, with Kuwait under direct missile and drone threat and the UAE severing financial ties with Iran. Iraq's Popular Mobilization Forces are under active attack in Kirkuk province with casualties reported. Yemeni forces are targeting Saudi mercenary positions in Mocha. Israel is conducting extensive ground and aerial operations across Lebanon and Gaza while maintaining heightened alert for cross-border threats.
sections.intelligence_notes: Economic warfare against Iran is accelerating dramatically, with the national currency losing over 10 percent of its value in two weeks and the gold coin Imami reaching 224 million tomans. The US has asserted operational control over the Strait of Hormuz, with CENTCOM reporting 86 commercial vessels rerouted. Israeli combat engineering units are systematically destroying Hamas underground infrastructure in Gaza over 26-kilometer routes. Hezbollah's underground facility beneath Ali Taher Ridge remains a persistent threat to Israeli forces in southern Lebanon.
